world: You are evaluating a synthetic AI-physics reasoning benchmark. A planar two-layer wall has layer 1 thickness L1 and conductivity k1, layer 2 thickness L2 and conductivity k2, and a finite thermal contact resistance Rc at the interface. The outer faces are held at Th and Tc with Th>Tc; there is steady one-dimensional conduction, no internal heat generation, and no convection boundary unless explicitly stated. The generator proposes the next short audit checkpoint; a separate rubric checks physical consistency. Do not carry out an experiment or use real data.

states.description: state the geometry, sign convention and no-source steady assumptions
draw the series thermal-resistance path including Rc
write the energy balance showing the heat flux is constant
write the temperature jump relation at the contact resistance
apply the hot-face and cold-face boundary conditions
solve the signed heat flux in terms of both layer resistances and Rc
solve the interface temperature from the same flux
check units and dimensions of the total resistance and heat flux
check the limiting case Rc approaching zero
flag a tempting error: forcing equal interface temperature or adding an unstated convection term
